I am an **agro-hydro-meteorologist** working on seasonal climate forecasting, hydrological modelling and machine learning for West Africa. I am the author of [**WASS2S**](https://github.com/hmandela/WASS2S), a Python framework for seasonal-to-subseasonal forecasting in West Africa.

[More about me →](about.qmd) · [En français →](about-fr.qmd)
